reachability.result: UNREACHABLE through ISOBMFF and Matroska (both feed Forward only through deliver_packets with a TrackIndex: isobmff.rs:1886 and :1926, matroska.rs:1528 and :1588). By reading, in this order: (1) every picture Forward::accept hands to the sink is a non-preroll chunk (video.rs:350 returns before picture_span at :391 for pre-roll); (2) a non-preroll chunk carries slots[slot], the pts of the FIRST presented entry of that media sample inside `wanted` (isobmff.rs:2081-2085 and :2111-2112); pre-roll chunks (:2113-2117) are the only chunks that get another pts; (3) `wanted` is a contiguous slice of track.presented (requested_range :1979-2000) and track.presented is non-decreasing in pts: build_presentation :1418-1490 walks the samples of each edit in pts order (order.sort_by_key :1430, pts_in_edit :377-389 is non-decreasing because media_to_ticks rounds NearestHalfUp, time.rs:8-10), the first entry of an edit that starts inside a sample is clamped to the edit start (:1455-1461), later edits start at or after the end of the previous edit (build_edits :1354-1409, start only grows by non-negative durations, entries past an edit's end are cut at :1467-1471), so every non-first entry of `wanted` has pts >= wanted[0].pts; (4) the only source of a negative presented pts is a track WITHOUT an edit list (build_edits :1320-1336: presentation_start = ticks(min(first sample pts, 0)); with an edit list presentation_start starts at 0 and only grows), and there the negative entries come first in presentation order; (5) deliver_packets refuses wanted[0].pts < 0 at isobmff.rs:2087 (to_ticks, :1730-1736) BEFORE its first read and sink call (:2107-2130), so a delivered pts is >= wanted[0].pts >= 0; (6) the end is pts + duration with duration unsigned, so it is >= pts >= 0. Therefore u64::try_from(pts) cannot fail for a delivered picture and neither could the removed u64::try_from(end).
